description: This file implements a default handler for D-Bus message handling, including object management, introspection, method invocation, and signal handling within the 'github.com/godbus/dbus/v5' package.

classes.name: defaultHandler
classes.description: Manages D-Bus objects, interfaces, and introspection, providing methods for object lookup, addition, deletion, and introspection XML generation.

classes.name: exportedMethod
classes.description: Wraps a reflect.Value to facilitate method invocation with argument handling and error processing.

classes.name: exportedObj
classes.description: Represents a D-Bus object with interfaces, supporting interface lookup, addition, and removal.

classes.name: exportedIntf
classes.description: Represents a D-Bus interface with methods and a flag indicating if it covers a subtree.

classes.name: defaultSignalHandler
classes.description: Handles D-Bus signals, allowing delivery, addition, removal, and termination of signal channels.

classes.name: signalChannelData
classes.description: Data structure for managing signal delivery channels, including synchronization and cleanup.

methods.name: newIntrospectIntf
methods.description: Creates an exported interface with an 'Introspect' method for object introspection.

methods.name: NewDefaultHandler
methods.description: Returns a new instance of the default D-Bus message handler.

methods.name: PathExists
methods.description: Checks if a given object path exists in the handler.

methods.name: introspectPath
methods.description: Generates an XML string representing the introspection data for a given object path.

methods.name: LookupObject
methods.description: Retrieves a D-Bus object at a specific path, including fallback subtree handling.

methods.name: AddObject
methods.description: Adds a new object at a specified path.

methods.name: DeleteObject
methods.description: Removes an object at a specified path.

methods.name: Call
methods.description: Invokes a method via reflection, handling errors and return values.

methods.name: NumArguments
methods.description: Returns the number of input arguments for the method.

methods.name: ArgumentValue
methods.description: Returns the default zero value for a method argument.

methods.name: NumReturns
methods.description: Returns the number of output values for the method.

methods.name: ReturnValue
methods.description: Returns the default zero value for a method's return value.

methods.name: newExportedObject
methods.description: Creates a new exportedObj instance.

methods.name: LookupInterface
methods.description: Looks up an interface by name within an exported object.

methods.name: AddInterface
methods.description: Adds an interface to an exported object.

methods.name: DeleteInterface
methods.description: Removes an interface from an exported object.

methods.name: LookupMethod
methods.description: Finds a method by name within an exported object's interfaces.

methods.name: newExportedIntf
methods.description: Creates a new exported interface with specified methods and subtree inclusion.

methods.name: LookupMethod
methods.description: Looks up a method by name within an exported interface.

methods.name: isFallbackInterface
methods.description: Checks if the interface is a fallback (subtree) interface.

methods.name: NewDefaultSignalHandler
methods.description: Creates a default signal handler instance.

methods.name: DeliverSignal
methods.description: Delivers a signal to all registered signal channels.

methods.name: Terminate
methods.description: Terminates signal delivery, closing all channels.

methods.name: AddSignal
methods.description: Adds a signal channel to the handler.

methods.name: RemoveSignal
methods.description: Removes a signal channel from the handler.

methods.name: deliver
methods.description: Delivers a signal to a specific channel, possibly deferring delivery.

methods.name: deferredDeliver
methods.description: Handles deferred delivery of signals in a goroutine.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the signal channel data, ensuring all goroutines complete.
